tool_schemas.name: get_book_by_title
tool_schemas.description: Searches Open Library by the provided book title, creating or reusing a cached query record and returning a normalized set of matching works/editions/authors from the cache when available (or after fetching and persisting results on a cache miss). Returns the normalized search response for the title; if the upstream returns multiple matches, the response includes the full cached match set rather than a paged listing. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when title is missing or empty, UNAUTHORIZED if the caller lacks access, RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded, UPSTREAM_ERROR when Open Library cannot be reached or returns an error, and NOT_FOUND when the title search completes successfully but yields no results.

title.description: The title of the book to search for.

tool_schemas.name: list_title_search_queries
tool_schemas.description: Lists cached title search query records visible to the calling API key, optionally filtered by status/title and ordered by most recently updated. Returns a paginated list; refuses requests for suspended/revoked API keys or when the daily quota is exhausted.

api_key.description: Caller API key credential used for authentication and quota enforcement.

title_normalized.description: Filter by exact normalized title value.

title_contains.description: Case-insensitive substring match against the raw title (implementation may normalize whitespace).

created_after.description: Return only queries created at or after this timestamp (RFC 3339).

created_before.description: Return only queries created before this timestamp (RFC 3339).

limit.description: Maximum number of query rows to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a prior response.

tool_schemas.name: get_title_search_query
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single title search query record by id (including its upstream metadata and cache expiration fields). Returns the query row; refuses access if the query does not belong to the calling API key, the API key is not active, or quota is exhausted.

api_key.description: Caller API key credential used for authentication and quota enforcement.

id.description: Primary key of the title_search_queries row to fetch.

include_results.description: If true, includes the associated title_query_results ordered by rank.

results_limit.description: Maximum number of result rows to include when include_results is true.

tool_schemas.name: create_title_search_query
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new title search query record for the calling API key in status queued. Computes title_normalized deterministically from title_raw, validates requested_limit (1–100), and returns the created query. Refuses empty/whitespace-only titles, non-active API keys, or requests that exceed the daily quota.

api_key.description: Caller API key credential used for authentication and quota enforcement.

title.description: Raw title to search; must be non-empty after trimming.

requested_limit.description: Maximum number of ranked matches to fetch/persist for this query.

tool_schemas.name: update_title_search_query
tool_schemas.description: Updates mutable fields on an existing title search query and/or performs a controlled status transition according to the lifecycle (queued↔fetching→succeeded/failed, with succeeded/failed allowed to re-queue). Returns the updated query. Refuses invalid lifecycle transitions, attempts to change immutable fields (including api_key_id/title_normalized), non-active API keys, or quota exhaustion.

api_key.description: Caller API key credential used for authentication and quota enforcement.

id.description: Primary key of the title_search_queries row to update.

status.description: New lifecycle status; must be a valid transition from the current status.

requested_limit.description: Update requested_limit for subsequent fetch attempts.

upstream_url.description: Upstream request URL used for the fetch attempt.

upstream_http_status.description: HTTP status code returned by the upstream Open Library call.

upstream_etag.description: ETag header from upstream response, if provided.

upstream_last_modified.description: Last-Modified header from upstream response, if provided.

error_code.description: Service-defined error code when status is failed.

error_message.description: Human-readable error message when status is failed.

fetched_at.description: Timestamp when the upstream fetch completed (RFC 3339).

cache_expires_at.description: Timestamp after which cached results should be treated as stale (RFC 3339).

tool_schemas.name: list_ol_works
tool_schemas.description: Lists persisted Open Library works in the cache, optionally filtered by Open Library work key, title, and status. Returns a paginated list; refuses requests for suspended/revoked API keys or when the daily quota is exhausted.

api_key.description: Caller API key credential used for authentication and quota enforcement.

ol_work_key.description: Filter by exact Open Library work key (e.g., "/works/OL...W").

title_contains.description: Case-insensitive substring match against the work title.

last_seen_after.description: Return only works last seen at or after this timestamp (RFC 3339).

limit.description: Maximum number of work rows to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a prior response.

tool_schemas.name: get_whoami
tool_schemas.description: Returns the authenticated caller identity for the provided API key, including current status, allowed scopes (if applicable), and quota usage for the current daily window. Refuses unknown keys and returns non-active status without allowing other operations.

api_key.description: Caller API key credential to introspect.

metadata.name: Open Library MCP Server
metadata.description: This backend stores cached Open Library search requests and the book/work records returned for a given title query.
